title: Allocation of interest and dividends.
bodyText: Interest and dividends are allocable to this State if the taxpayer's commercial domicile is in this State.
bodyHtml: §235-27  Allocation of interest and dividends.  Interest and dividends are allocable to this State if the taxpayer's commercial domicile is in this State. [L 1967, c 33, pt of §1; HRS §235-27]
